environment.scope: Repository-only operator tooling. The ADR-0117 section-3 single-entry INGEST contract already existed but had no concrete wrapper for the standing/uncapped case (provision_and_open_oneshot.py is ATTEST + max_uses 1; Open-GuvfxCopierVerifierWindow.ps1 is backend-only, caps 1-50, auto-closes). The wrapper assumes the documented SINGLE Sponsor-gated operator model. It hardens the concurrent case (a foreign window opened in the preflight->open TOCTOU gap is left intact, not clobbered), but it does NOT hold an exclusive lease; the backend DB partial-unique constraint on state=OPEN still guarantees at most one window. True multi-operator concurrency is out of the threat model.
No PowerShell artefact was added or changed (the host provisioner Provision-GuvfxCopierEmitterKey.ps1 is unchanged), so a Windows PS 5.1 ParseFile gate is Not Applicable to this packet.

Backend absence/validity signals come from the reviewed provisioner's own -Remove/-Verify results (value-blind, metadata only); the wrapper never reads, hashes or echoes the key. Definitive host-side ACL/identity enforcement remains in the reviewed provisioner, not the wrapper.
